newsitem.title: USA: KCS Energy says completes acquisition.
newsitem.headline: KCS Energy says completes acquisition.

text.p: KCS Energy Inc said Friday it has completed its acquisition of InterCoast Oil and Gas Co and two gas marketing subsidiaries of MidAmerican Energy Co for about $210 million in cash and 435,000 warrants to purchase KCS common stock.
The warrants have a four-year term and an exercise price of $45 per share.
InterCoast is a Tulsa, Okla.-based oil and gas exploration and production subsidiary of MidAmerican.

KCS President and Chief Executive James Christmas said in a statement that the acquisition doubles the company's total oil and gas production and proved reserves, and increases its cash flow by more than 50 percent.
